title: REQ · preload.test.ts proves BootScene uses the planner and fallback
summary: BootScene.preload and resolveKey are asserted from game/tests with mocks
description: Context: BootScene imports '@game/...' aliases, which game/vitest.config.ts does not define, so game/tests cannot import it. Desired behavior: add the alias and test BootScene with phaser, content and fallback loader mocked. Expected result: tests show only planned assets load, unknown refs warn, and resolveKey returns 'fallback:missing' for unknown or failed ids. Why: SG-5.4.3 done-when.
acceptance_criteria: Given scene refs 'objects/bed' (known) and 'objects/ghost' (unknown), when preload runs, then load.image is called once for the bed and console.warn reports ghost
Given preload ran, when generateTexture is inspected, then it was called with 'fallback:missing'
Given an unknown or loaderror-failed id, when resolveKey runs, then 'fallback:missing' is returned; known id returns itself
technical_constraints: vi.mock('phaser') and the content module; no real Phaser
